skills.name: Swift (疾)
skills.line: You don't stay alert, you die.
skills.description: SP Yamakaze charges at a single target and launches a 2-strike attack, dealing damage equal to 40% of his ATK with each strike.

skills.name: Orders (令)
skills.line: Prey, I've got my eye on you.
skills.description: Each time Briskey gains 1 MP during battle, SP Yamakaze's move bar is increased by 1%. When a control effect is dispelled or expires on him, if he's not inflicted by any additional control effects, his move bar is increased by 30%. Then Briskey consumes all MP (max of 60) by an additional 1% for each MP consumed. When dealing damage, SP Yamakaze deals an extra by 0.5% of damage for every 1% of HP the enemy has lost. ;Briskey (迅風) :At the start of SP Yamakaze's turn, if he not inflicted with any control effects, Briskey the owl will execute a command from one of these skills: Briskey's Shelter, Briskey's Hunting Eyes and Briskey's Blow Off. :''(MP is represented by a yellow bar under Briskey's skills.)''

upgrades.text: Damage from AOE attacks is decreased by 50%.
At the start of his turn, his Crit DMG is increased by 1% for each 1 MP Briskey has.
Each time an ally receives a crit attack, increases his move bar by 10% (only triggers once per attack).
At the start of battle, Briskey gains 20 MP.

skills.name: Briskey's Shelter (迅・庇羽)
skills.description:
:Gain 40 MP upon using this skill.
Briskey hovers behind an ally, creating an undispellable shield that can absorb 75% of SP Yamakaze's ATK and grants them 100% of Crit RES, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Briskey's Hunting Eyes (迅・猟目)
skills.description:
:Gain 40 MP upon using this skill.
Briskey gazes at the an enemy and decreases their ATK, DEF and SPD by 35%, lasts for 2 turns. Briskey can only gaze at 1 enemy at a single time.

skills.name: Briskey's Blow Off (迅・撃空)
skills.description:
:Consumes 60 MP upon using this skill.
Briskey hovers before 1 enemy, blowing them of the ground. Their souls and passive are Sealed when blown off the ground. When the enemy lands, they receive damage equal to 240% of SP Yamakaze's ATK. 
Monsters cannot be blown off the ground. Instead, they receive damage equal to 480% SP Yamakaze's ATK when landing. Then Briskey gains 40 MP.

skills.name: Storm (嵐)
skills.line: Rots with the fallen leaves now that the wind has stopped.
skills.description: SP Yamakaze rushes towards an enemy with a vortex of fire and slashes them 4 times, dealing damage equal to 63% of his ATK with each slash.

bio.condition: In , have SP Yamakaze defeat 2 enemies at the same time in 1 turn.
With SP Yamakaze win 10 times in against Yamakaze.
